# CONSUMER_NON_CYCLICALS — sector digest, ISO week 2026-W46

**Coverage changes.** Forty-four names reached print this week (30 initiations, 13 updates, one refresh), lifting the desk to 59 published, 42 parked and 36 queued [coverage index]. PLANTATIONS: fourteen, mostly bullish — BUY LSIP Rp4,668 vs Rp1,560 (+205% TR), BUY SGRO Rp5,592 (+54%), BUY DSNG Rp2,438 (+94%), BUY AALI Rp20,917 (+125%), BUY ANJT Rp2,919, BUY TLDN Rp1,028, BUY BISI Rp798, BUY BWPT Rp303; ADD FISH, HOLD PNGO; SELL NSSS Rp349, SELL MKTR Rp79, SELL CBUT Rp618, REDUCE MGRO. FOOD_BEVERAGE: fifteen — BUY CEKA Rp3,021, MLBI Rp7,274, SKBM Rp739, CAMP Rp203, DLTA Rp2,050; ADD STTP; HOLD ADES Rp29,620, CLEO Rp387, TGKA Rp4,605; REDUCE GOOD Rp215, ROTI Rp346, YUPI Rp1,042; SELL BEEF Rp58, FORE Rp286, STRK Rp4. POULTRY_FEED: BUY CPIN Rp5,240 (+131%), JPFA Rp2,289, CPRO Rp61; SELL SIPD Rp189, UDNG Rp22. STAPLES_RETAIL: BUY AMRT Rp1,189, HERO Rp427, MIDI Rp343; REDUCE BUAH; SELL RANC. PERSONAL_HOUSEHOLD: BUY MRAT Rp505, UCID Rp704; HOLD KINO; REDUCE TCID; SELL VICI.

**Deck moves.** Agri forecasts unchanged (last reviewed 27 October); daily marks refreshed to 13 November leave wheat US$218.6/t (−25.5% vs FY2027E US$293.5), corn US$176.4 (−17.8% vs US$214.6) and soymeal US$363.3 (−11.6% vs US$411.0) below the modelled path — a feed-cost tailwind [agri deck]. CPO spot is still the September Pink Sheet print of US$1,180 against FY2026E US$1,135; a refresh is due [agri S1]. Macro: USD/IDR Rp18,190 and BI rate 5.75% [macro deck].

**Material news.** From 1 January 2027 palm exports must route through PT Danantara Sumberdaya Indonesia's platform, service fee still unset [12a494f5; 9a22caca]. GAPKI warned El Niño could cut national palm output by 3m tonnes [ce8be12a; d7108f09]. CPIN booked Rp5.18trn of nine-month profit [55eb2f57]; the government capped DOC prices at Rp7,000/chick [447e3a02]. ADES split 1:10 for free float [31b52174]; BEI is investigating NSSS trading concentration [7a7f1088]; GGRM enters the LQ45 on 18 November [780a5412].

**What to watch.** The DSI service fee; the December CPO reference price against the US$1,135 path; whether feed grain spot converges upward; and the 42-name parked backlog, including SIMP, UNVR, TAPG and ULTJ.

*Research only; not a recommendation to act.*
